# J P Traders

> J P Traders is a pharma and FMCG wholesale distributor based in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India, operating since 1994. It supplies 7,000+ products across 135+ companies and 2,000+ molecules to 3,400+ retail medical stores through a direct ordering app.

## Key facts

- Founded: 1994
- Location: J P Heights, Mangalwar Peth, Kolhapur, Maharashtra 416012, India
- Catalog: 7,000+ active products, 135+ companies, 2,000+ distinct molecules, 48 product categories
- Retailers served: 3,400+
- Ordering channels: the J P Traders app (app.jpkop.in), WhatsApp, or a visiting salesman
- Contact (WhatsApp/phone): +91 77218 81599, +91 94220 46470

## Guides

- [How to order from the app](https://app.jpkop.in/how-to-order): a 5-step walkthrough for a retailer to install the app and place a first order.

## Notes

Most of app.jpkop.in sits behind a retailer or staff login and is intentionally excluded from indexing (see /robots.txt) — the blog, the how-to-order guide and this file are the only pages meant for public and AI-crawler access.
